subject: 市场棚
prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Image 1 is a precisely measured 3-by-2 market stall BLOCKOUT, not the desired art style. TEXTURE AND DETAIL THIS PIXEL-LOCKED BLOCKOUT into a sober highly realistic Qing northern Chinese market-stall game sprite. Keep its precise ground quadrilateral and camera unchanged. Do NOT recenter, enlarge or stretch. Its ground corners LEFT(180,555), FRONT(840,885), RIGHT(1280,665), REAR(620,335). The two visible ground edges have EXACT slopes +0.5 and -0.5 and horizontal lengths660 and440: ratio3:2. Keep the top four corners and posts directly above those base corners. Replace flat tan canopy with sagging natural unbleached coarse linen tied with ropes to four plain aged dark timber posts. Sagging is permitted only between fixed corners; canopy corners remain at given geometry. Add one simple wooden table with shallow bamboo grain and vegetable baskets beneath canopy. All table edges use the same two axes. Ground pad is one thin rectangular firm-earth slab with perfectly straight edges and clear left/front/right corners. Remove all outlines through natural fine textures. Texture density and realistic warm-gray sober tones matching a historical Chinese city-map sprite kit, not cartoon, not low-poly. Soft upper-left lighting, tiny lower-right contact shadow. The rectangular plan is the key: preserve its width/depth and BOTH slopes symmetrically exactly. TRUE transparent RGBA background outside the object. Complete isolated sprite with transparent margins. No lettering, guides, diagrams, labels, people, modern objects, signage, thick pedestal, landscape, watermark, halo or glow. ONE small market stall.
negative: 文字、人物、水印、现代物、背景场景、厚地台、裁边、透视汇聚

projection_contract.note: 投影目标，不宣称生成图精确满足；实测见geometry_qa。

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize rounded to integer dimensions
paste without mask on transparent canvas, minimum 16px margins; no repaint/warp/flip/alpha threshold

notes: 第2次运行返修，2候选选2；体块仅为image_gen生成参考，成品仅裁切、等比LANCZOS缩放、透明留白。逐张view_image并浅底alpha合成检查。3×2占地宽深误差0.14%；前轴斜率0.5405仍较0.5偏0.0405，超过现有±0.03阈值，保留如实告警。清北匿名功能建筑（原创扩展）；status仍为candidate。
